name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's path to motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a fascination for the intricate workings of engines as a child. This led to a degree in mechanical engineering, before he realized his true calling lay in the financial side of complex systems. He earned a Master's in Finance, focusing on motorsport economics. Dirk joined Cavaleiro Sports after a brief stint at a regional accounting firm, drawn by the team's ambition and commitment to sustainable growth. 

As Finance Controller, Dirk is meticulous in tracking every expense and revenue stream, ensuring the team operates within budget and maximizes its resources. He's known for his calm demeanor, even when faced with tight deadlines and unexpected financial challenges. His detail-oriented approach and ability to explain complex financial data in a clear and concise manner make him an invaluable asset to the team.

Dirk's understanding of both the technical and financial aspects of motorsport gives him a unique perspective, allowing him to identify potential cost savings and investment opportunities that others might miss. He's passionate about ensuring that Cavaleiro Sports has the financial stability to compete at the highest level.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Dirk is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always has a small notepad and pen, even in meetings.
Prefers to work standing at his adjustable desk.
Drinks green tea religiously throughout the day.
